subject: Human Evolution
title: Portable Art
description: A quick win: understand Portable Art.

hook.text: Not all ice age art stayed on walls. Carved figurines, engraved bones, and decorated tools traveled.

buildup.text: Portable art includes ivory beads, carved animals, and ornate spear-throwers found across Europe.

discovery.text: These objects reveal personal expression and regional style—different groups had recognizable aesthetics.

twist.text: Some carved pieces are found hundreds of kilometers from their source—evidence of trade or migration.

climax.text: Portable art proves individual identity and group belonging mattered deeply during the ice age.

punchline.text: Art you carry tells the world who you are.

quiz.question: What does portable ice age art reveal?
options: Personal identity, trade networks, and regional styles
